arxiv-2001-07238.title: RDSP: Rapidly Deployable Wireless Ad Hoc System for Post-Disaster Management
arxiv-2001-07238.creator: Ajmal Khan, Adnan Munir, Zeeshan Kaleem, Farman Ullah, Muhammad Bilal, Lewis Nkenyereye, Shahen Shah, Long D. Nguyen, S. M. Riazul Islam, Kyung-Sup Kwak *
arxiv-2001-07238.description: Abstract In post-disaster scenarios, such as after floods, earthquakes, and in war zones, the cellular communication infrastructure may be destroyed or seriously disrupted. In such emergency scenarios, it becomes very important for first aid responders to communicate with other rescue teams in order to provide feedback to both the central office and the disaster survivors.

arxiv-2103-15498.creator: Manish Anand
arxiv-2103-15498.description: Abstract The main aim of the present work is to analyse the effect of dipolar interaction strength λ \lambda , particle size D D and temperature T T on the hysteresis mechanism in ordered arrays of magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) using computer simulations. The anisotropy axes of the MNPs are assumed to have random orientation to mimic the real system.

arxiv-2301-04526.title: Sensitivity of DUNE to low energy physics searches
arxiv-2301-04526.creator: on behalf of DUNE collaboration
arxiv-2301-04526.description: Abstract The Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE), a next-generation long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiment, is a powerful tool to perform low energy physics searches. DUNE will be uniquely sensitive to the electron-neutrino-flavour component of the burst of neutrinos expected from the next Galactic core-collapse supernova, and also capable of detecting solar neutrinos.

arxiv-2305-08175.title: An Optimal and Scalable Matrix Mechanism for Noisy Marginals under Convex Loss Functions
arxiv-2305-08175.creator: Yingtai Xiao, Guanlin He, Danfeng Zhang, Daniel Kifer
arxiv-2305-08175.description: Abstract Noisy marginals are a common form of confidentiality-protecting data release and are useful for many downstream tasks such as contingency table analysis, construction of Bayesian networks, and even synthetic data generation. Privacy mechanisms that provide unbiased noisy answers to linear queries (such as marginals) are known as matrix mechanisms.

arxiv-2401-10414.title: A Fluctuation-Response Relation as a Probe of Long-Range Correlations in Non-Equilibrium Quantum and Classical Fluids
arxiv-2401-10414.creator: T.R. Kirkpatrick 1 and D. Belitz 2,3
arxiv-2401-10414.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by T.R. Kirkpatrick 1 and D. Belitz 2,3. The absence of a simple fluctuation-dissipation theorem is a major obstacle for studying systems that are not in thermodynamic equilibrium. We show that for a fluid in a non-equilibrium steady state characterized by a constant temperature gradient the commutator correlation functions are still related to response functions; however, the relation is to the bilinear response of products of two observables, rather than to a single linear response function as is the case in equilibrium.

arxiv-2411-08971.title: Challenges in constraining dust properties from starlight polarization
arxiv-2411-08971.creator: Raphael Skalidis
arxiv-2411-08971.description: Abstract Context. Dust polarization, which comes from the alignment of aspherical grains to magnetic fields, has been widely employed to study the interstellar medium (ISM) dust properties. The wavelength dependence of the degree of optical polarization, known as the Serkowski relation, was a key observational discovery that advanced grain modeling, and alignment theories.

arxiv-2502-18232.title: A Reverse Mamba Attention Network for Pathological Liver Segmentation Thanks: This project is funded by NIH grants: R01-CA246704, R01-CA240639, U01-CA268808, and R01-HL171376.
arxiv-2502-18232.creator: 1 st Jun Zeng, 2 nd Debesh Jha, 3 rd Ertugrul Aktas, 4 th Elif Keles, 5 th Alpay Medetalibeyoglu, 6 th Matthew Antalek, 7 th Robert Lewandowski, 8 th Daniela Ladner, 9 th Amir A. Borhani, 10 th Gorkem Durak, 11 th Ulas Bagci
arxiv-2502-18232.description: Abstract We present RMA-Mamba, a novel architecture that advances the capabilities of vision state space models through a specialized reverse mamba attention module (RMA). The key innovation lies in RMA-Mamba’s ability to capture long-range dependencies while maintaining precise local feature representation through its hierarchical processing pipeline.

arxiv-2505-16963.title: A Formal Proof of Complexity Bounds on Diophantine Equations
arxiv-2505-16963.creator: Jonas Bayer, Marco David
arxiv-2505-16963.description: Abstract We present a universal construction of Diophantine equations with bounded complexity in Isabelle/HOL. This is a formalization of our own work in number theory [ 1 ] . Hilbert’s Tenth Problem was answered negatively by Yuri Matiyasevich, who showed that there is no general algorithm to decide whether an arbitrary Diophantine equation has a solution.

pmc-10522938.title: Infant embodied attention in context: Feasibility of home-based head-mounted eye tracking in early infancy
pmc-10522938.creator: Jessica Bradshaw, Xiaoxue Fu, Julia Yurkovic-Harding, Drew Abney
pmc-10522938.description: Social communication emerges from dynamic, embodied social interactions during which infants coordinate attention to caregivers and objects. Yet many studies of infant attention are constrained to a laboratory setting, neglecting how attention is nested within social contexts where caregivers dynamically scaffold infant behavior in real time.

pmc-10597484.title: USP7 attenuates endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced apoptotic cell death through deubiquitination and stabilization of FBXO7
pmc-10597484.creator: Su Hyoun Lee, Kwang Chul Chung
pmc-10597484.description: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disease (NDD) characterized by the loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra. Similar to other NDDs, the buildup of toxic protein aggregates in PD leads to progressive neuronal loss, culminating in neurodegeneration.

pmc-10824939.title: Maternal obesity induced metabolic disorders in offspring and myeloid reprogramming by epigenetic regulation
pmc-10824939.creator: Joo Young Kweon, Hyeonji Mun, Myeong Ryeol Choi, Hong Seok Kim, Yong Joo Ahn
pmc-10824939.description: Maternal obesity and gestational diabetes are associated with childhood obesity and increased cardiovascular risk. In this review, we will discuss and summarize extensive clinical and experimental studies that metabolically imbalanced environment exposure in early life plays a critical role in influencing later susceptibility to chronic inflammatory diseases and metabolic syndrome.

pmc-12645448.title: Fabrication of Single-Bacterium Microgel with Gas-Shearing Strategy for Precision Probiotic Delivery in IBD Therapy
pmc-12645448.creator: Jialin Wu, Lili Wu, Ruiying Liu, Leyan Xuan, Jiamin Qian, Chenchen Fang, Huaibin Wang, Jie Guo, Lingran Du, Yingling Miao, Bin Liu, Yutao Liu, Guosheng Tang
pmc-12645448.description: The human gut microbiome is essential for maintaining health, as it substantially impacts immune regulation and overall balance within the body. Accordingly, disruptions in this microbial community are associated with various diseases. Probiotics offer a promising solution, but their effectiveness is often hampered by challenges related to gastrointestinal delivery.

pmc-12714733.title: Appraisal of groundwater susceptibility to pollution using hybrid framework of stable isotopes and indexed approach
pmc-12714733.creator: Kamilia Hagagg, Nadia Mahmoud Sirag
pmc-12714733.description: This study presents an integrated framework for assessing groundwater contamination risks by combining intrinsic aquifer vulnerability, isotope hydrology, and geospatial pollutant loading indicators. A two-dimensional vulnerability mapping approach was developed using a modified GOD index and δ1⁸O stable isotope tracer, enabling evaluation of both vertical and lateral contaminant transport within the aquifer system.

pmc-12783298.title: Reimagining invasive weeds through a preliminary antibacterial and phytochemical evaluation of Ipomoea purpurea (L.) Roth floral and seed ethereal extracts

pmc-13116758.title: Effects of Web-Based Physical–Cognitive Telerehabilitation Exergaming on Physical and Cognitive Performance in Chronic Stroke Survivors: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13116758.creator: Puntarik Keawtep, Sirinun Boripuntakul, Piangkwan Sa-nguanmoo, Pranglada Jearjaroen, Cattaleeya Sittichoke, Teerawat Kamnardsiri, Thepparit Sinthamrongruk, Somporn Sungkarat
pmc-13116758.description: As stroke survivors often manifest not only physical dysfunction but also cognitive impairment, interventions that address both physical and cognitive aspects may be beneficial for individuals with chronic stroke. However, a randomized clinical trial (RCT) examining the effects of physical–cognitive telerehabilitation exergaming across physical and cognitive domains in chronic stroke survivors remains scarce.

pmc-13182016.title: Long RNA profiles of endometrial extracellular vesicles provide new insights into the pathogenesis of ovarian endometriosis
pmc-13182016.creator: Qizhen Chen, Ao Li, Shana Guo, Jing Chen, Wen Li, Yanqiu Wang
pmc-13182016.description: BackgroundOvarian endometriosis(OEM) is a highly prevalent condition that significantly affects women’s health. Tissue-derived extracellular vesicles(Ti-EVs) contain multiple molecules that maintain intercellular communication. They participate in pathological processes contributing to the progression of OEM. However, little is known about the roles of long RNAs within Ti-EVs in OEM.
